name: Shared packages and tools
summary: The foundation every Velexis app builds on: seven shared TypeScript packages (config, logger, crypto, db, errors, api-types, testing) and the tools around them (Amadeus stub, Playwright e2e harness, reference-data loader, CI checks, plan linter, perf smoke test, dev key script). Half A of this guide covers packages/*, half B covers tools/*.
audience: Owner hunting bugs (DB migrations, reference data, error codes, redaction, test harness)
Backend developers (tenantTx, platformDb, envelope encryption, error catalogue)
Test authors (template databases, Mailpit, Amadeus stub, Stripe events, Playwright)
Operator on the VM (migrate.js, reference loader, KEK rotation)
package: @velexis/config, @velexis/logger, @velexis/crypto, @velexis/db, @velexis/errors, @velexis/api-types, @velexis/testing; tools: @velexis/amadeus-stub, @velexis/e2e, @velexis/reference-data (+ plain Node folders tools/ci, tools/perf, tools/plan-lint, tools/dev)
stack: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo; exact dependency versions
openapi-typescript 7.13.0, Redocly CLI 2.82.0, Ajv 8.20.0 + ajv-formats 3.0.1, yaml 2.9.1
Amadeus stub: Node http, no framework; reference data: OpenTravelData (CC BY 4.0) + Unicode CLDR 48.2.0

local.command: pnpm build && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed:reference && pnpm stub:amadeus
local.notes: Libraries: nothing to start except the Amadeus stub (127.0.0.1:4900) and, for tests, Mailpit (SMTP 127.0.0.1:1025, UI/API http://127.0.0.1:8025). Prerequisites: deploy/scripts/dev-setup.sh, pnpm dev:keys, cp .env.example .env.local (development values only). Tests: pnpm test, pnpm test:int, pnpm test:e2e.

production.host: No host of its own: the runtime packages ship inside the backends' releases; on the VM velexis-deploy runs db/dist/cli/migrate.js (platform, reference, tenants) and reference-data/dist/cli/load.js before switching releases. Test packages, the stub and tools/e2e never reach the VM.

talksTo.how: Imported at run time: config, logger, crypto (credentials, MFA secrets), db (platformDb, migrations), errors (exception filter), api-types (types, job validation); @velexis/testing in its tests

Imported at run time: tenantTx for every tenant query, migrateTenantSchema for provisioning, envelope encryption of tenant columns, redactPayload, storage adapter, job validation; @velexis/testing and the Amadeus stub in its tests
config, logger, errors (code → message), api-types (platform types); e2e journeys drive it
config, logger, errors, api-types; e2e journeys drive it
config, logger, errors; e2e journeys drive it
Types through the SDK; e2e storefront journeys drive the production build in vite preview
JSDoc types from @velexis/api-types only; @velexis/testing in its tests
velexis-deploy runs migrate.js and the reference loader as transient units (migrator.env, reference-loader.env); CI workflows run tools/ci, plan-lint, e2e

data: reference.currencies, countries, time_zones, cities, airports, airlines, aircraft (written only by the reference loader as velexis_platform_app)
platform.schema_migrations, reference.schema_migrations, tenant_<key>.schema_migrations (migration ledgers written by migrate.js)
platform.tenants (read by the tenant fan-out: status IN provisioning, active, suspended)
tenant_<key> schemas: created by migrateTenantSchema as velexis_provisioner, default privileges for velexis_ota_app

*_ciphertext + encryption_key_id columns (platform.accounts, supplier_connections, amadeus_accounts, payment_provider_connections, credential_submissions, provisioning_jobs; tenant saved_travelers, saved_traveler_documents, checkout_travelers, booking_travelers, notifications) — formats owned by @velexis/crypto

Scratch databases: velexis_test_tpl_<runId>, velexis_test_<runId>_<random> (integration tests), velexis_e2e_<runId> (Playwright), velexis_codegen_<pid> (db:codegen), velexis_dbtest_<random> (@velexis/db tests)
Redis: databases 1–15 for tests (useRedis), database 15 for the e2e stack (E2E_REDIS_DB); queue names vx:<queue> and channel vx:invalidate defined in @velexis/api-types

roles.name: velexis_migrator
roles.can: DDL on platform and reference; runs migrate.js; owns the ledgers; reads platform.tenants for the fan-out

roles.name: velexis_provisioner
roles.can: Owns every tenant_<key> schema (SET LOCAL ROLE in the runner); no writes on platform or reference

roles.name: velexis_platform_app
roles.can: DML on platform and reference (the reference loader's role); never anything in tenant schemas

roles.name: velexis_ota_app
roles.can: DML in tenant schemas through default privileges; SELECT on reference and the platform tables of R__ota_read_access.sql; search_path pg_catalog

roles.name: velexis_test_admin
roles.can: Local and CI only: CREATEDB, member of velexis_migrator; creates and drops test, e2e and codegen databases

roles.name: Developer
roles.can: Runs every command locally; records stub fixtures and refreshes reference data by hand

roles.name: CI (GitHub Actions)
roles.can: Runs plan-lint, check-package-json, tests, generators-up-to-date, test:int, e2e; never records fixtures or downloads reference data
